decks.name: LeetCode #121 - Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
decks.description: Find the maximum profit from buying and selling a stock once

cards.question: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock: You are given an array prices where prices[i] is the price of a given stock on the ith day. You want to maximize your profit by choosing a single day to buy one stock and choosing a different day in the future to sell that stock. Return the maximum profit you can achieve from this transaction. If you cannot achieve any profit, return 0.

solutions.name: Dynamic Programming
solutions.explanation: Track the minimum buy price seen so far while iterating through prices. For each price, calculate the potential profit if we sell at that price, and update the maximum profit. This one-pass approach achieves O(n) time with O(1) space.

solutions.name: Two Pointers
solutions.explanation: Use two pointers: left for buying and right for selling. If we find a cheaper buy price, move left to right. Otherwise, calculate profit and keep moving right. This sliding window approach achieves O(n) time with O(1) space.
